//: Typecheck config for the Cloudflare Worker entry (#1050).
worker/index.ts is what wrangler.jsonc points `main` at, so it is the
production entry point, and it was excluded from every typecheck: bundled by
esbuild, which strips types without checking them. An undefined name there
throws on the first request the Worker serves.
Two things make this its own config rather than part of the app's:
* `types` is the Workers runtime, not the DOM plus Node. `ExecutionContext`
and friends exist only there, and pulling those globals into the app's
program would change what typechecks across every file in src/.
* the entry imports `../.open-next/worker.js`, which does not exist until
`opennextjs-cloudflare build` has run. That import carries an
@ts-expect-error, so it is silent either way, but the DIRECTIVE flips
between used and unused depending on whether the artifact is present.
scripts/test-worker-typecheck.ts therefore ignores TS2578 and says why:
a check whose verdict depends on whether somebody has built recently is
Like the scripts tree, this is NOT demanded to be clean; the guard fails on
the classes that break at runtime.
